shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view feature; ground level draws no band).
- Selection survives column view switches. Mountain rivers MOVE, not duplicate. River flow data optional (terrain-keyed gen).
- Pocket maps: celestial/climate reads resolve through the GROUND map. Pocket-level fog meshes can bake stale; LevelComp self-heals (one-shot WholeMapChanged(FogOfWar) on first view/session).
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable).

## SKYLIGHTS: REMOVED (user directive, 2026-07-24, round 7)
The entire Batch-D skylight feature is deleted after repeated live failures: zone designators, WorkGiver + JobDrivers, SkylightMapComp/SkylightSystem/shaft thing, AB_Skylight terrain, architect patch, setting, Keyed strings, and every renderer/selection/orders/gen integration (glass click-through, glass visibility, glass mask tint + frames, level-0 below band, two-deep stacked view, pane mesh mirrors, glass rooftop revert). The below view is once again a SKY-VIEW-ONLY feature. `disableSkyLighting` on AB_Underground REVERTED per "return the prior basement behavior" — basements render as before round 5.
**Postmortem for any future revisit** (the diagnostics were converging): (a) black basements were NOT the skylights — missing disableSkyLighting + a latent stale fog-mesh bake (self-heal now shipped and KEPT); (b) shaft sun must read the GROUND map (pocket maps lack celestial data); (c) the last unverified defect was "panes don't light below" — the under-pane light-diagnostic click never happened, so the shaft gate chain (feature/sun/chainOpen) was never observed live. Old test saves containing glass/shafts will log missing-def noise on load — expected, throwaway quicktest saves only.

## VERIFIED / RESOLVED THIS SESSION
- **RMB cross-level: USER-VERIFIED** (Notify_SwitchedMap selection wipe fixed via column selection preservation; ReplayFresh fresh-regeneration replay; stairs right-click option; hop-chain routing).
- **Black basements + "all fog" fully root-caused**: stale fog-mesh bake (self-heal KEPT) + fog color camouflage; biome flag trial reverted with feature removal.
- **Rivers**: silent no-op root-caused (empty riverFlowMap variant) → flow-optional rework built; starter stairs in the ensure tool. AWAITING fresh-column verification (river diagnostic: expect carved/dried, wet-under-mass=0).
- Waterfall [StaticConstructorOnStartup]; pet-return scribing; wild hard-overdue escape; direct-to-blueprint continuation; below-level lighting band (sky view; `belowLighting` setting); BAM compat; perf pass + perf-mod audit — all built, standing.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky + basement (spawns starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic (biome/stairs/fog%/links/drawer) · AB: river diagnostic (genstep LastSummary + live counts) · AB: light diagnostic (glow/sun/glowers/power) · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## Test plan (next round)
1. Rivers on a fresh column: river diagnostic (carved/dried, wet-under-mass=0); banks, dry tunnel bed, falls at ledges.
2. Basement sanity: prior behavior restored (renders as pre-round-5), stairs from the ensure tool, fog shroud gone (self-heal active).
3. Below lighting from the sky view (lamp pools through the gap at night).
4. Then the standing stack: animal flow, direct-to-blueprint, BAM (companion), Batch B/C, perf-mod smoke, translation audit, soak, publishing.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 parity (VERIFIED) · direct-to-blueprint hauling · below-level lighting (sky view) · animal flow fix · BAM compat · perf pass + perf-mod audit (PO/TPT decompiled, invariants documented) · mountain rivers (superseding, flow-optional) · Batch A verified · Batch B/C built pending · logistics/areas/combat as documented passes 9-15. SKYLIGHTS REMOVED.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH. Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. CE. Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF. Medieval Trader Airships (+legacy), Hospitality (Continued). Better Architect Menu. Performance Optimizer + Dubs Performance Analyzer + Turret Performance Tweaks (decompile-audited). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (16th pass): **skylights fully removed (8 files deleted, 10 files cleaned, build green, zero stragglers); prior basement behavior restored; fog-mesh self-heal and starter-stairs tooling retained**. Next round: river verification on a fresh column + basement sanity.
